open_points.subject: SpooledFile M22 creation and record ownership
open_points.text: “Two have several, on purpose: StoredValue M21 ... and NodeExecution M23 ...” conflicts with “The module that writes a StoredValue M21 or a SpooledFile M22 sets its class ... `runs` for ... function outputs ... `effects` for service outputs” and with “`store.spool_file` alone checks both ceilings”.
open_points.question: Which module owns creating and writing a SpooledFile record: `store`, `runs` and `effects` as separate writers, or one domain module called by both producers?
options: `runs` and `effects` each build M22 and call `store` only for atomic persistence and bytes
`store.spool_file` builds M22 from facts supplied by `runs` or `effects`
A separate spool-owning domain module creates M22 for both producers
open_points.default_guess: Treat `runs` and `effects` as intentional co-writers of M22, with each deciding its disclosure class and `store.spool_file` owning only persistence, ceiling enforcement and attempt-number assignment.
